2610.04693.title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
2610.04693.paper_summary: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candidates; at equal records it covers 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration, and the gain is confined to the axis it targets. On 60 screened obligations of a financial advisory constitution, Penumbra returns 144 pairs, each a compliant and a violating response that the committee places on opposite sides of the boundary, differing by a handful of words where a model asked for both directly produces texts sharing almost nothing. A second constitution, for clinical triage, reproduces this on 18 obligations: 49 pairs at the same tightness, with the same modes hardest. Pairs like these show where an obligation's own terms stop deciding, which is what an agent deployed under it must be tested against, and the search finds them at a cost that scales with the boundary, not the text.
2610.04693.paper_summary_zh: 代理人正在進入金融、醫療和法律等領域，在這些領域中，違規行為不會留下詞彙簽名，並且會帶來實際的懲罰。是否遺漏是重大，或披露是否足夠，取決於回應中遺漏了什麼。探討這種義務意味著尋找一個最小編輯即可顛覆合規性的回應，而每次探查都需要一代人和兩次裁決的成本，因此對於監管紅隊的約束條件是樣本效率，而不是數量。我們引入了Penumbra，這是一種對抗性搜索，從經過驗證的錨點出發，在擴展的編輯預算下行走，直到兩位評估委員會改變其裁決，並發出兩個相鄰的回應，這些回應跨越了變化。分配是自適應的，目標是覆蓋失敗面：每個候選人解決的不同（義務 x 失敗模式）單元。在匹配預算的情況下，自適應分配在59%的候選人中達到了均勻分配的全預算覆蓋；在相等記錄下，它覆蓋了天真的枚舉的1.43倍失敗模式，並且增益僅限於其目標軸。在60個篩選的金融諮詢憲法義務中，Penumbra返回144對，每對都是一個合規和一個違規的回應，委員會將其置於邊界的兩側，僅在幾個詞上有所不同，而模型要求兩者時，直接生成的文本幾乎沒有共享內容。第二部憲法，針對臨床分診，對18個義務重複了這一過程：49對在同樣的緊密度下，具有相同的最困難模式。這些對顯示了義務自身條款停止決策的地方，這正是根據其部署的代理人必須進行測試的地方，而搜索以與邊界相關的成本找到它們，而不是文本。
2610.04693.author: Anthony Rhodes et.al.
